explication: stb is a collection of independently embedded, single-file C/C++ libraries rather than one runtime application. The principal workflow is: an application includes one library with its implementation macro, calls its API, and receives decoded, generated, transformed, rendered, parsed, or stored data. The graph groups the documented capabilities by domain. Source excerpts directly support image decoding/resizing, font rasterization, audio decoding, and utility internals; other capabilities are retained from the README and tree, with wiring shown only at their documented API boundaries.
